<context_for_action>
The apt-get timeout occurred after successfully downloading 118 out of 119 packages. The downloaded packages may still be in the apt cache. Before attempting a fresh install, try completing the interrupted installation with `dpkg --configure -a` followed by `apt-get install -f`. This could complete the installation without re-downloading, saving time. If that fails, then proceed with a minimal install (`apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends gcc make`) with a longer timeout.
</context_for_action>
